note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records from Mundra Sea and Nhava Sheva Sea to the USA, Peru, Argentina, Bahrain, Israel, Saudi Arabia and Malaysia, with HS codes 0904/0909/0910/1108/1207/1211/0910 — i.e. the declared HS set (071220;071290;090111;090121) is only partly matched: dried-vegetable headings 0712 and coffee 0901 were not observed in the visible rows, while the actual observed codes are spices/oilseeds/starch/senna. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the observed codes and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. Note that two related records exist at the same address — 'KORE INTERNATIONAL' (proprietorship/unknown form, 1302 records) and 'KORE INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED' (339 records); the legal form of the claimed entity is not verifiable from public sources here, so it is left as claimed. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views and are recorded as null — not estimated. Domestic (intra-India) supply evidence: none found in reachable sources, so 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' is used, since the search backend was unavailable and the absence is a tooling limitation, not a verified absence.
